content: Yes, that is true. In Switzerland, every person who is at least 18 years old and holds Swiss citizenship is eligible to vote, but to actually vote, they must be registered in the electoral register of their place of residence (municipality). This registration is done automatically when you register as a resident with the local authorities, so you do not need to take additional steps beyond becoming a resident. Once registered, you receive voting materials for federal, cantonal, and municipal votes and elections.
